Title: Reduce outpatient pharmacy wait times
Objective: Cut lunchtime pickup waits by staggering staff breaks and adding a pre-pack queue for refills.

Title: Lower the audiology no-show rate
Objective: Send 72-hour text reminders and keep a same-week backfill list for open slots.

Title: Clear the community care consult backlog
Objective: Schedule every pending community care consult within 30 days of the referral.

Title: Same-day mental health access
Objective: Offer same-day mental health appointments until 4:30pm instead of redirecting walk-ins to the ED.

Title: Spanish discharge instructions on 4 West
Objective: Give every Spanish-speaking Veteran discharge instructions in Spanish, using translated templates.

Title: Improve OR first-case on-time starts
Objective: Start first surgical cases on time by fixing tray completeness, anesthesia staffing and pre-op flow.

Title: MRI standby list
Objective: Fill late-cancelled MRI slots from a list of Veterans who can come in on short notice.

Title: Standardize new-hire onboarding
Objective: Replace six service-specific onboarding checklists with one shared checklist and get IT access ready on day one.

Title: Wheelchairs at the main entrance
Objective: Keep wheelchairs available at the main entrance all day with return stations on inpatient units.

Title: ICU supply PAR levels
Objective: Reset supply PAR levels on 3 East ICU so nurses stop borrowing supplies from other floors.
